description: BCIM - Ponte - 1:1 000 000 - 2016 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A classe Ponte faz parte da categoria Sistema de Transportes da Base Cartográfica Contínua do Brasil, ao milionésimo – 1: 1 000 000 (BCIM), é um conjunto de dados geoespaciais de referência, estruturados em bases de dados digitais, permitindo uma visão integrada do território nacional nesta escala. Coverage: Brasil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
